# hammer

> creative technologist. ten-plus years on broadcast and agency pipelines, now producing with ai. la · ny · remote. film + animation, vfx + cgi, interactive demos, motion graphics, brand systems, websites, pipelines.

Important context:
- canonical url: https://hammer.ad
- public brand: Hammer / hammer, not the domain name
- primary entity: Jeff Hammer, Creative Technologist
- contact: hammer@hammer.ad
- site model: visual-only portfolio. no blog, no /notes, no /process, no /lab.
- best agent entry points: /llms-full.txt, /.well-known/agents.json, /sitemap.xml, /sitemap-priority.xml, /memories/jeff.md.

## work

- [atrium](https://hammer.ad/work): 7 portfolio categories. each a collection of pieces.
- [film + animation](https://hammer.ad/work/film-animation): commercial film and ai-native video. Live: the Equinox campaign spot, the gunfight (a 92-second western comedy made with Seedance 2.5), and code animation. Code animation is The North Wind and the Sun, an 82-second Aesop fable drawn entirely in code, plus six short films.
- [vfx + cgi](https://hammer.ad/work/vfx-cgi): Blender, Runway, Hunyuan 3D, and gaussian splat pipelines. Live: environment swap, a gaussian splat of the gunfight main street (Hunyuan 3D meshes, Blender, Brush, Spark viewer), and a blender look-dev pipeline.
- [interactive + playable](https://hammer.ad/work/interactive-playable): live demos: Sushi Scramble, a three.js third-person sushi shooter; and a 35mm projector anatomy figure (no provider calls). A capped prompt-to-storyboard demo draws a six-panel colour-pencil board with GPT Image 2.5.
- [motion graphics](https://hammer.ad/work/motion-graphics): programmatic motion built in remotion + hyperframes. icm teaser, motion graphics reel, Spring Health showcase, and a Minimax H3 spotify title study are live.
- [brand systems](https://hammer.ad/work/brand-systems): identities built with ai in the loop. hammer · kira · agentify dossiers are live; Kira covers the agent identity, bible, and website. The Agentify dossier links to https://agentify.nexus/brand-bible.
- [websites](https://hammer.ad/work/websites): ai-native websites. hammer, agentify.nexus, onlykira.ai, and coefficient.mythx.art have Hammer preview pages, then link to the live sites.
- [pipelines + tools](https://hammer.ad/work/pipelines-tools): the tools beneath the work. pipeline visualizer and creative skills are live detail surfaces.

## about

- [bio](https://hammer.ad/about): jeff hammer. ten-plus years on broadcast and agency pipelines, now producing with ai. clients include cadillac, columbia pictures, equinox, fox, ihg hotels, lululemon, porsche, rémy martin. agencies include angry gods, chandelier creative, pg & co, conscious minds, look.
